data.body:
PRODUCTION VALIDATION COMPLETE — fix is live and verified by an on-demand RED->GREEN probe.

## Probe design
Any Gerrit action that sends a notification triggers the fault. The reliable one is
posting a review comment on a change owned by SOMEONE ELSE — Gerrit does not email you
about your own action, so commenting as the change owner would send nothing and give a
false clean. Probe used: comment as JoeOakhartNava on change 1068 (owned by RebarBotNava).
The log had just rotated at UTC midnight, so the before/after is unambiguous.

## RED (pre-restart, 2026-07-31T00:07:37Z)
    [2026-07-31T00:07:37.175Z] [SendEmail-1[send-email comments]] ERROR
      com.google.gerrit.server.change.EmailReviewComments : Cannot email comments for 1068,3
    com.google.gerrit.exceptions.EmailException: Mail Error: Connection refused
        at com.google.gerrit.server.mail.send.SmtpEmailSender.open(SmtpEmailSender.java:457)

## Apply (2026-07-31T00:16:55Z)
`sendemail.enable=false` set in the LIVE site config via `git config -f`, deliberately
NOT by copying the repo file over it: the live config carries the OAuth client-id
substituted from SSM by compose-up, and a blind copy would have restored the
`__GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID__` placeholder and broken OAuth on boot. Verified after the
edit: client-id intact (4 refs), placeholder count 0. A backup was left at
`gerrit.config.bak-1630`. `/opt/rebar`'s copy was also refreshed so a later compose-up
re-seeds the new config rather than reverting it.
`docker restart compose-gerrit-1` — Gerrit healthy again in 30s.

## GREEN (post-restart, 2026-07-31T00:17:41Z)
Identical probe, same author, same change, same patchset. No new log entry.

Every `Cannot email` entry in today's log:
    00:07:37 00:08:07 00:08:36 00:10:40 00:10:41 00:11:34
    00:11:46 00:12:44 00:13:17 00:13:40 00:15:09 00:16:40
All 12 precede the 00:16:55 restart. ZERO after it. The last one lands 15s before the
restart; the GREEN probe 46s after it produced nothing.

Liveness control (so "no errors" is not just "Gerrit is quiet"): 66 log lines were
written in the minutes AFTER the restart. Gerrit is actively serving and simply no
longer attempting SMTP. Running config confirms `sendemail.enable=false`.

## Corrections to earlier claims on this ticket
1. I earlier reported the box's deploy repo as "stale since 2026-07-03", inferred from
   the mtime of `/opt/rebar/infra/compose/gerrit.config`. That inference was WRONG:
   `rsync -a` preserves source mtimes and `git checkout` only rewrites changed files, so
   a July 3 mtime only means the file had not changed in git since then.
2. The broader "stale deploy" claim was also wrong. An `rsync --dry-run` of the mirror at
   origin/main against `/opt/rebar` showed NO content drift — the only itemized diffs
   were artifacts of my own exclude list plus a timestamp-only delta on the file I had
   already copied. Because `src/rebar/` is in BOT_PATHS and changes constantly, the full
   rsync runs on most deploys and carries infra/ with it.
3. What actually happened is narrower: this config landed, `deployed-sha` advanced past
   it, and no review-bot source change had triggered an rsync in the interim. The next
   bot deploy would have carried the file anyway.

The residual gap the CONFIG_PATHS change addresses is still real and unchanged by the
above: the deploy marker advances without materializing infra files, and since
`changed()` compares DEPLOYED..TARGET, a gerrit.config edit never reappears in a later
window — so without the signal an operator has no way to know a Gerrit restart is owed.
Autodeploy never restarts Gerrit by design, so the signal is the only mechanism.
